Title: Ishaan and the Family

Cast

1. Ishaan - 12 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Sunita - 40 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Anil - 42 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ishaan stands in the living room. Sunita and Anil stand near him.]

Anil: "Today feels like a good day."

[Ishaan does his homework at the table.]

Anil (happily): "What next?"

[Ishaan talks to his father on the phone.]

Ishaan: "I'm ready!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Sunita stands near him.]

Ishaan: "Mom, look over here."

[Ishaan starts crying.]

Ishaan: "Yes, all right."

[Ishaan smiles at Mother.]

Sunita: "Are you okay?"

[Ishaan stamps his foot in anger.]

Ishaan: "That was such a fun day!"
